en-US:
What's new in 1.11.1:
• Fixed: crashes when transcribing long, high-quality recordings on low-memory phones • Community catalog: Canary entries renamed to NVIDIA's official Canary Flash names • From 1.11.0: any audio length with any model; visible, cancellable queue showing model and duration; community catalog with many languages and the Canary tier for lighter phones; native language names; integrity-checked downloads; fixed Qwen3-ASR failing to load
What's new in 1.11.0:
• Any audio length with any model: long recordings are split and stitched automatically • Visible queue: items appear instantly, cancellable; each entry shows the model and duration • Community catalog, one-tap imports in many languages, plus the new Canary tier (en/de/es/fr) for lighter phones • Native language names; integrity-checked downloads • Fixed: Qwen3-ASR failing to load
What's new in 1.10.0:
• Import your own models: custom transcription models from a folder or link (Transducer, Whisper fine-tunes, CTC, SenseVoice), verified and each with its own share target • Model tab redesigned, honest speed/quality comparison • NNAPI acceleration on every device, automatic CPU recovery • Fixed: Gemma selection crash (broke 1.9.2 on F-Droid); quantized Parakeet failing to load • Engines unified: smaller app, faster updates
What's new in 1.9.2:
• Maintenance release: improved build reproducibility for F-Droid delivery. No user-facing changes.
What's new in 1.9.1:
• Fixed: the Parakeet (quantized) model was crashing silently; model files are now validated before loading, so a broken download is caught instead of crashing • Clearer, specific error messages: you now see the actual reason (corrupt model, internal error, no model loaded) instead of a generic "transcription failed" • Crash recovery: if a crash happens, the app reopens on the Model tab and points you to re-download the affected model • Default transcription engine is now Parakeet TDT (was Gemma), matching the most-downloaded model • Removed unused storage permissions (READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE); all file access uses the system file picker • Clearer error when an unsupported audio format is shared
What's new in 1.9.0:
• Fixed: the Parakeet (quantized) model was crashing silently; model files are now validated before loading, so a broken download is caught instead of crashing • Typed error handling: transcription failures now show specific messages (corrupt model, internal error, no model loaded) instead of a generic "transcription failed" • Crash prevention: invalid model files are detected before loading, preventing silent app crashes • Crash recovery: if a native crash occurs, the app guides you to re-download the model on next launch • Default backend is now Parakeet TDT (was Gemma), matching the most-downloaded model
What's new in 1.8.5:
• Removed the unused storage permissions (READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) - the app never needed them; all file access uses the system file picker. Clearer error message when an unsupported audio format is shared.
What's new in 1.8.4:
• Per-architecture APK splits (smaller downloads) and compressed native libraries
What's new in 1.8.3:
• Maintenance: the sherpa-onnx speech engine is now built from source for F-Droid, and the bundled library is no longer shipped as a committed binary
What's new in 1.8.2:
• Removed unused ad-tracking permissions (AD_ID, ad-services attribution) that Firebase Analytics injected — the app's permission list now genuinely matches its "no tracking, no ads" promise • Privacy: dropped Firebase Analytics entirely; crash reporting (Crashlytics) is unaffected
What's new in 1.8.0:
• New: Save transcripts to a folder — auto-save every transcription as a .txt to a folder of your choice (Drive, Syncthing, Dropbox, anything). Great for building your own archive or sync pipeline • Fixed: the global Auto-Copy toggle now works for all apps, not just WhatsApp (#13) • Fixed: the "transcription was interrupted" dialog no longer appears on normal completion (#11) • Fixed: Nemotron no longer cuts off the end of short messages • Updated inference engine (sherpa-onnx 1.13.4) with cleaner transcript output formatting
What's new in 1.7.0:
• Detect and extract embedded subtitles from video files before transcribing (closes #9) • Accept video files as transcription input (the audio track is transcribed) • Navigate completed chunks from the in-progress notification while a long transcription runs • Hardened Gemma/LiteRT on multi-chunk audio; fixed a release-only WorkManager crash • LiteRT-LM 0.12.0 → 0.13.1 (MTP runtime support); stale .litertlm models prompt re-download
What's new in 1.6.1:
• Nemotron now streams transcription text progressively as it decodes • Nemotron now appears in the "retry with another model" picker • Fixed the "Active" badge wrapping its last letter in the model card • Nemotron info now lists supported languages instead of "unknown"
What's new in 1.6.0:
• New Nemotron 3.5 streaming backend — transcription text appears progressively in real time • Parakeet: better quality on long audio via SmoothQuant int8, with automatic fallback to the stock model • Per-stream language selection for Nemotron transcriptions • Obsolete model folders are cleaned up automatically • Updated inference libraries for performance and stability
What's new in 1.5.4:
• Upgraded sherpa-onnx to v1.13.2 for improved ONNX inference
What's new in 1.5.3:
• Fixed long transcriptions silently dropping the last segment on low-memory devices • Failed chunks are now retried with memory cleanup before giving up • Notification warns when transcription is incomplete (some chunks failed)
What's new in 1.5.2:
• Improved audio resampling for better transcription accuracy
What's new in 1.5.1:
• Improved audio resampling for better transcription accuracy
What's new in 1.5.0:
• Major transcription engine upgrade with new backend options • Improved model management and download experience • Performance optimizations for faster on-device inference
What's new in 1.4.0:
• Picture-in-Picture mode — see live transcription text in a floating window while using other apps • Edge-to-edge display for Android 15+ (SDK 35) with proper system bar handling • Concurrent model downloads with per-download progress tracking • Swipe-to-reveal actions on log entries (copy, share, delete) • Auto-hide Logs tab header on scroll for more reading space • Model installation guidance notification when no model is configured • Fixed truncated transcriptions with WhisperX-style Cut & Merge chunking • Fixed KeyStore corruption recovery for EncryptedSharedPreferences • Fixed cancelled transcriptions stuck as PENDING • Fixed notification tap not scrolling to the transcribed message
What's new in 1.3.1:
• Complete Italian translation — 28 previously missing strings now translated (Performance Stats, Transcription ETA, Progressive Display, model dialogs) • Fixed "Today"/"Yesterday" showing in English in the Logs tab on Italian locale • Fixed English strings appearing throughout the Settings tab when using Italian • Fixed notification service showing English error and progress messages on Italian locale • Fixed accessibility content descriptions not localized (screen reader support) • Fixed cancelled transcriptions getting stuck as PENDING instead of being marked as ERROR • Fixed notification tap not scrolling to the transcribed message in the Logs tab
What's new in 1.3.0:
• Added Qwen3-ASR as a 4th transcription backend (0.6B int8) for multilingual speech recognition • Added Gemma 4 E2B and E4B model support for multimodal on-device transcription • Added configurable transcription language setting • Added short audio fast-path that skips chunking for better responsiveness • Graceful dialog on unsupported devices instead of native crash • Centralized model management — deduplicated downloaders, backend IDs, and validation logic • Improved model unload button visibility (only shown when a model is loaded) • Restored distil-whisper model with correct multilingual metadata • Added many new unit and instrumented tests for better reliability
What's new in 1.2.3:
• Fixed Gemma transcription crash ("Conversation is closed") that could occur when the LiteRT-LM session was accessed concurrently
What's new in 1.2.2:
• Fixed crash on startup caused by Android KeyStore corruption (app now recovers automatically — user may need to re-enter their HuggingFace token)
What's new in 1.2.1:
• Fixed crash when sharing audio from older Android versions (Android 11 and below) • Updated native libraries for 16 KB memory page size support • Upgraded build toolchain (Kotlin 2.2, AGP 8.10, Gradle 8.11.1)
What's new in 1.2.0:
• Whisper model downloads now use individual files from HuggingFace instead of tar.bz2 archives, for faster and more reliable downloads • Added Firebase Crashlytics for centralized crash reporting
What's new in 1.1.1:
• Reset per-app notification settings to defaults (individual or all at once) • Onboarding tooltip for per-app settings • Fixed wasted vertical space in Logs tab header • Fixed UI flicker on cold start
What's new in 1.1.0:
• Configurable inference thread count with automatic CPU core detection • Queue-aware sharing: toast notification when sharing while transcription is active • Adaptive transcription ETA with real-time per-batch feedback • Transcription logs now persist in a local database • Queue-aware notifications for multiple concurrent transcriptions • Settings changes are blocked during active transcription to prevent errors
What's new since 1.0.3:
• VAD-based silence stripping before transcription • Parallel transcription of audio chunks for faster processing • Distil-Whisper Large v3 Italian model support with speed comparison UI • ExtractionService for resilient model downloads with progress tracking • HuggingFace authentication with download resume and retry • Calibration-based progress ETA and performance stats • LiteRT-LM backend for multimodal on-device inference (Gemma models with audio)
